copy.headline: What do you want to move forward?

projectBlocked.title: Unblock this work: {{blockedReason}}
projectBlocked.prompt: Project {{projectName}} is blocked by: {{blockedReason}}. Check the relevant context, identify the smallest executable way to unblock it, and proceed.

projectFailure.title: Resolve the latest failure: {{recentFailure}}
projectFailure.prompt: Project {{projectName}} recently failed: {{recentFailure}}. Find the cause, propose the smallest fix, and explain how to verify it.

projectNextAction.title: Continue: {{nextAction}}
projectNextAction.prompt: Continue the defined next action for project {{projectName}}: {{nextAction}}. Check the current state, then carry it out.

taskAttention.title: Resolve the open question: {{attentionSummary}}
taskAttention.prompt: Task {{taskTitle}} needs attention: {{attentionSummary}}. Explain what decision or input is needed from me, then continue.

taskFailure.title: Recover the failed task: {{recentFailure}}
taskFailure.prompt: Task {{taskTitle}} recently failed: {{recentFailure}}. Analyze the cause, fix recoverable problems, and show verification before retrying.

taskReview.title: Review the result and close the gaps
taskReview.prompt: Check task {{taskTitle}} against its acceptance criteria. List passes, gaps, and evidence, then decide whether it is complete.

taskClosed.title: Summarize the result and remaining work
taskClosed.prompt: Summarize the result, verification evidence, and remaining work for task {{taskTitle}}, then decide whether a follow-up task is needed.

taskNextAction.title: Continue the next action: {{nextAction}}
taskNextAction.prompt: Continue the defined next action for task {{taskTitle}}: {{nextAction}}. Check the task constraints, then proceed.

workflowFailure.title: Recover the failed workflow: {{recentFailure}}
workflowFailure.prompt: Workflow {{workflowName}} recently failed: {{recentFailure}}. Locate the failed stage and propose a safe recovery plan.

workflowNextAction.title: Continue the workflow: {{nextAction}}
workflowNextAction.prompt: Continue the defined next action for workflow {{workflowName}}: {{nextAction}}. Check existing outputs before proceeding.

workflowReview.title: Summarize this workflow run
workflowReview.prompt: Review the result and outputs from workflow {{workflowName}}. Summarize completed work, verification evidence, and anything that still needs attention.
